messages:
jordan: Heads up — scheduling a maintenance window for Dedicated GPUs to deploy kernel + runtime patches. Window: 2026-05-12 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need status page copy + customer email template. Affects: Dedicated customers in eu-west-1 and us-east-1 with pinned model versions. No data loss expected. Canary first 5% for 30m. @lee can you draft PS update? :eyes:

lee: Draft below — please review.

lee: ```status page
Incident type: Planned maintenance
Start: 2026-05-12 02:00 UTC
End: 2026-05-12 04:00 UTC
Services impacted: Dedicated inference (eu-west-1, us-east-1)
Summary: Applying kernel and runtime security/performance patches. Customers may observe short tail-latency spikes or transient retries. No customer data changes expected.
Updates: We'll post a start, midpoint (if the window exceeds 30m), and a completion entry with duration and any follow-ups.
```

emily: Email subject suggestion: [Redwood] Scheduled maintenance — Dedicated inference (May 12)

sam: Ops note for rollback triggers: rollback if p99 latency increases >30% or error rate >0.5% sustained for 15m. Canary policy: 5% traffic, checks on p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, and token throughput.

jordan: Add note about version pinning: customers with pinned model versions will not have model binaries changed, only runtime/kernel. Link to docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/dedicated/maintenance

deploy-bot: Automated reminder scheduled for 2026-05-11T08:00:00Z

lee: Customer email template draft: 

lee: ```email
Subject: [Redwood] Planned maintenance for Dedicated inference — May 12
Hello <CustomerName>,

We will perform scheduled maintenance on our Dedicated GPU infrastructure on 12 May 2026 between 02:00–04:00 UTC to apply security and performance patches. During this window you may see brief increases in tail latency or retries. There is no expected data loss and your pinned model versions will remain unchanged.

If you rely on strict latency SLOs during this window and would like to request an exemption or reschedule, please reply to this message or contact your account representative.

We will post live updates to https://status.redwood.ai and follow up once the maintenance is complete.

Regards,
Redwood Inference Ops
```

emily: Add blurb for status page cadence: post at start, post at 30m if still ongoing, post at completion with total downtime and any mitigation steps. Keep public messages short; route enterprise notes to account teams.

jordan: LGTM. @deploy-bot, please schedule the status page posts and reminder emails. I'll own outreach for enterprise customers.

sam: I'll attach the rollback runbook and canary metric dashboard to the internal ticket and prepare support playbook Q&A (FAQ about retries, retries client best-practices, pinning notes).

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled posts will be created 24h and 1h before the window and a start message at window open.

lee: Thanks — I'll post these drafts to the dedicated-maintenance thread in #support and make the customer templates available in the ops playbook.

jordan: Great. Dry run at 2026-05-11 10:00 UTC — please confirm attendance.
